## ShipmentTracker - Blazor Web App

**Architecture:** Blazor Web App with **Interactive WebAssembly** render mode and prerendering.

### Why WebAssembly?
- **Fast first load** — server-side prerendering delivers HTML immediately
- **No server round-trips** after WASM loads — interactive controls run in the browser
- **Global users** — no persistent SignalR connection needed (unlike Server mode), so latency doesn't affect interactivity
- **All pages interactive** — `--all-interactive` flag applies the render mode globally

### Key features:
| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|---------------|
| Dispatcher dashboard | `/shipments` — full list with create/update controls (role-gated) |
| Customer view | `/shipments` — filtered to own shipments only |
| Tracking page | `/track` — search by tracking number, shows status + progress bar + ETA |
| Auth | ASP.NET Identity with Individual accounts, roles (Dispatcher/Customer) |
| API | Minimal API endpoints at `/api/shipments` with role-based authorization |

- **Dispatcher:** `dispatcher@shiptrack.com` / `Dispatch1!`
- **Customer:** `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`
